steps.label: Terms email
steps.title: Guarantee terms and the delay record
steps.explanation: The booking terms allow a surcharge credit after billing review if a carrier-caused delay is confirmed, and the route record shows a carrier sorting delay with no exclusion. The credit still needs billing's approval.

facts_upsert.text: DL-050 was guaranteed by 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC; the surcharge is GBP 7.50.
Under the booking terms, if a carrier-caused delay is confirmed, the surcharge may be credited after billing review.
The route record shows a carrier sorting delay; the actual recipient handover was at 2026-03-23 08:40 UTC.
